name: csv-tools
title: CSV Tools
description: Inspect, filter, sort, and edit CSV text with CSV File Tools.
author: scott_paulin

ai.instructions: Work only with CSV text explicitly supplied by the user. CSV is transmitted to https://csvfile.tools/api/csv/mcp for processing. Never fetch URLs or read local paths through these tools. Limits: 256 KiB UTF-8 input/output, 50,000 cells, 200 columns, 1,000 edits, 20 preview records. Cells are literal strings; never evaluate formulas. Delimiter must be explicit. Row and column indices are zero-based, including headers for edits. Preserve the complete returned CSV.

commands.name: open-csv-editor
commands.title: Open CSV Editor
commands.description: Open the free CSV editor in your default browser to edit local CSV files.
